mapper.insert: insert into task_collaborator ( task_no, project_member_no, task_collaborator_ctime ) values ( #{taskNo}, #{projectMemberNo}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select tc.task_no as taskNo, tc.project_member_no as projectMemberNo, tc.task_collaborator_ctime as taskCollaboratorCtime, pm.emp_no as empNo, e.emp_name as memberName, e.emp_dept_no as deptName, e.emp_position_no as jobPosition from task_collaborator tc inner join project_member pm on tc.project_member_no = pm.project_member_no inner join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no where tc.task_no = #{taskNo} order by tc.task_collaborator_ctime asc
